checks.name: chk_certificado_reemissao
checks.clause: ((versao = 1) and (id_certificado_anterior is null) and (motivo_reemissao is null) and (reemitido_em is null) and (id_usuario_reemissor is null)) or ((versao > 1) and (id_certificado_anterior is not null) and (motivo_reemissao is not null) and (char_length(trim(motivo_reemissao)) between 3 and 500) and (reemitido_em is not null) and (id_usuario_reemissor is not null) and (snapshot_json is not null))

checks.name: chk_certificado_revogacao
checks.clause: ((status = _utf8mb4\'ATIVO\') and (revogado_em is null) and (id_usuario_revogador is null) and (motivo_revogacao is null)) or ((status = _utf8mb4\'REVOGADO\') and (revogado_em is not null) and (id_usuario_revogador is not null) and (motivo_revogacao is not null))
